doc: docs/automation-foundations.md#secrets-register. GUARD path (owner Approve at head). Checked by scripts/check-secrets-register.mjs (rules a-f) and scripts/check-identity-register.mjs (GET /user, drill A36). actual_scope is NOT VERIFIED for every token: nothing here can read a token scope; never invent one.

owner_credentials.name: owner-pc-gh-session
owner_credentials.note: 6.1a: the owner's own gh session on the owner's PC. NOT an automation credential; no unattended workflow may use it. Not a repo secret, so no workflow can name it.

entries.name: AUTOMERGE_TOKEN
entries.contract_text: 6.1: PAT used by merge lane, bot-automerge; minimum contents:write + pull-requests:write on the one repo it serves, no admin, NO workflow/workflows permission, no variables; may be read by workflows triggered by push to main, schedule, workflow_dispatch, pull_request_review running main's definition; expiry date recorded in the register; alert 7 days ahead.
entries.note: no AUTOMERGE_TOKEN secret in this repo (measured 2026-11-05, run 41990183311); owner dropped the author/merge separation 2026-11-05

entries.acts_as_state: measured 2026-11-05 by the identity check, run 41990183311
